exit 0
--- stdout
Withdraw the ruling for an exact command. Submitted receipts that deferred it
under the ruling no longer satisfy reviewer assignment and need fresh admission;
receipts that executed it are unaffected.
Usage:
liza deferred-validation unrule [flags]
Flags:
--command string exact canonical command
-h, --help help for unrule
--json output result as structured JSON
Global Flags:
--check-update check for a Liza update before running
-C, --project-root string Liza project root for state commands
--update-channel string update check channel: stable or main (default "stable")
-v, --verbose verbose output
--- stderr
